definitions.explanation: A thin strand of fiber used for sewing or weaving.
The strings on a musical instrument.

examples.japanese: {糸|いと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{糸|いと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{結|むす}ばれている→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's said that the two are connected by a red thread of fate.
examples.notes: Cultural reference to fate connecting lovers

examples.japanese: ⟦{三味線|しゃみせん}→三味線：04464_shamisen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{糸|いと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}り{替|か}える→張り替える：28418_harikaeru⟧。
⟦{三味線|しゃみせん}→三味線：04464_shamisen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{糸|いと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絹|きぬ}→絹：01383_kinu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Shamisen strings are made of silk.

notes:
{糸|いと} means 'thread' or 'string.'

Counter: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧

Common compounds:
- ⟦{毛糸|けいと}→毛糸：00212_keito⟧: yarn, wool
- ⟦{絹糸|きぬいと}→絹糸：noentry⟧: silk thread
- ⟦{縫|ぬ}い→縫う：00326_nuu⟧{糸|いと}: sewing thread

Cultural note: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{糸|いと} (red thread) refers to the Japanese/Chinese legend that an invisible red thread connects those destined to meet, especially romantic partners.

Related words:
- ⟦{紐|ひも}→紐：02251_himo⟧: string, cord (thicker)
- ⟦{縄|なわ}→縄：03511_nawa⟧: rope (much thicker)
